procedural_matters: SUI 1808 was represented by Lorenz Kausche.
The panel was changed in accordance with RRS 63.7(c)(2) by adding the following members: Yoann Peronneau and Christine Guba.
facts: On 28 May 2026, during hearing No. 19, the international jury learned that SUI 1808, which was not a party to the hearing, was involved in the incident and may have broken a rule.
In accordance with RRS 63.2(d), the international jury closed the current hearing and lodged hearing No. 25, in which they protested SUI 1808 under RRS 60.4(c)(2).
On 29 May 2026, the panel of the international jury heard hearing No. 19 together with hearing No. 25 and decided to disqualify SUI 1808.

At 18:26, SUI 1808’s representative lodged a request to reopen hearing No. 25, claiming that an arbitration meeting was not held prior to the hearing, and that he was not offered to take a Post-Race Penalty.
conclusions: Since hearing request No. 25 was lodged by the international jury, an arbitration meeting could not be held according to RRS T2.
Since RRS 44.1(b) did not apply, SUI 1808 could have taken a Post-Race Penalty at any time after the race until the beginning of hearing No. 25, in accordance with RRS T1(a).
The international jury did not make a significant error in the
. Therefore, the requirements in RRS 63.7(a)(2) for reopening the hearing are not met.
decision: Hearing No. 19 heard with No. 25 will not be reopened.
